title: Predicting Student Performance Using Synthetic Big Data and XGBoost
summary: A course project (CSCI-620) that generates a 25-million-record synthetic student dataset to train and evaluate an XGBoost GPA-prediction model, comparing synthetic-trained versus original-trained performance. It fits and samples from SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata schema to produce the large-scale synthetic training data.
evidence: Final_Submission.ipynb:1243-1251 fits/saves GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata) and synthesizer.fit(sample_df) to generate the synthetic dataset
